title: Exceptional preservation for all-continuous algebraic-closure coefficients
statement: Fix a prime ell and a field k of positive prime characteristic p different from ell. Let X,Y be separated finite-type k-schemes and f:X -> Y a separated finite-type k-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring isomorphic, as a ring object, to S |-> C(S,Qbar_ell), with ALL continuous maps for the induced ell-adic topology [sk-def-localizing-closure]. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories with the pulled-back coefficients, let Loc(Dctf) be the localizing closures [sk-def-localizing-closure] of the bounded constructible finite-Tor objects [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Fix a boundary compactification c of f and a proof h that its actual compactification lower shriek preserves those closures. For any right adjoint G to that restricted lower shriek and any supplied adjunction [sk-prop-sf-existence], G sends Dctf(Y,Lambda) into Dctf(X,Lambda). This assertion only states preservation, without constructing functor restrictions or a restricted adjunction.

source.place: First two paragraphs, affine factorization and local exceptional preservation.

proof.text: Choose the finite affine chart factorizations used in unit sk-thm-restriction. Using composition and open-restriction adjunctions and uniqueness of right adjoints, identify u^* G with i^! p^! v^*. This is the same geometric argument as det-thm-restriction-local, but it must be performed for the present all-continuous-map coefficient; that node is only a template, since its existing Lean Qbar disjunct differs.

proof.text: For this same coefficient, compute the affine-space exceptional inverse image by the rational purity calculation and compute the closed exceptional inverse image by the support fiber. Pullback of finite scalar models, the locally free Tate line and the finite bounds on the open direct image give bounded constructibility and finite Tor bounds on each chart. These coefficient-specific purity and open-image calculations are the unresolved mathematical work here; the existing finite-subextension-valued interfaces do not supply them. The source route is retained rather than asserting an isomorphism of coefficient rings.

source.place: The affine-factorization and finite-cover arguments in the first two paragraphs, and the restricted Hom bijection in the last paragraph.

proof.text: Exact open restriction commutes with cohomology and derived tensor. Minima and maxima over the finite chart cover give uniform cohomological and Tor bounds; vanishing on the cover detects global vanishing. A finite common refinement of the local constructible stratifications supplies the same finite scalar models on each nonempty stratum. For empty X, use the empty-cover sheaf axiom instead of extrema. This proves the stated preservation for the supplied G, and scalar transport along the supplied ring isomorphism gives the general Lambda formulation.
